births_total.methodology_url: Number of births (total) - is the sum of the number of complete separations of the fetus from the mother's body, regardless of the gestational age. A live birth is a child born alive even with breathing, heartbeat, pulsation of the umbilical cord, and involuntary muscle contractions. In this case, the mother's pregnancy must be 22 weeks or more, the child's height must be 25 cm or more, and its weight must be 500 grams or more. Detail: https://lib.stat.uz/uz/features/demografiya-va-mehnat/853-asosiy-demografik-ko-rsatkichlarni-shakllantirish-bo-yicha-uslubiy-nizom-2
births_total.department: Department of Demography, Labor and Gender Statistics
notes: Bozatov district was established in 2020; The city of Takhiatash was closed in 2013 and formed in 2018 as Takhiatash district; The city of Shahrisabz was founded in 2018; The city of Gazgan was founded in 2020; Bandikhan district was formed in 2020; The city of Nurafshan was founded in 2018; The city of Ahangaron was founded in 2018; Yangiyul city was founded in 2018; Tashkent district was established in 2018; The city of Khiva was founded in 2018; Tuproqqala district was established in 2021; Yangihayot district was formed in 2021; Kokdala district was formed in 2022.

deaths_total.methodology_url: Number of deaths (total) is the sum of the numbers of complete cessation of biological and physiological processes of the body's life. Detail: https://lib.stat.uz/uz/features/demografiya-va-mehnat/853-asosiy-demografik-ko-rsatkichlarni-shakllantirish-bo-yicha-uslubiy-nizom-2

labor_resources.methodology_url: The number of labor resources – The number of labor resources is defined as the sum of the number of the population of working age and the number of workers of younger and older age than the working age according to the following formula:  LR = WAPM + WTP, where: LR – labor resources; WAPM – working-age population of working age;  WTP – working teenagers and pensioners. Detail: https://lex.uz/en/docs/3469431
labor_resources.department: Department of Demography, Labor and Gender Statistics

economically_active_population.methodology_url: Economically active population – employed citizens and unemployed. Detail. https://lex.uz/en/docs/3469431
economically_active_population.department: Department of Demography and Labor Statistics

employment_rate.methodology_url: Employment rate – the number of people employed in the economy is calculated by dividing by the number of people of working age and multiplying by a hundred. Detail: https://lex.uz/en/docs/3469431
employment_rate.department: Department of Demography, Labor and Gender Statistics
notes: The ratio of the number of employed population to the working age population
Preliminary data for 2024

unemployed_population.methodology_url: Accounting is carried out in accordance with Article 44 of the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan “On employment of the population”.  The number of persons in need of employment (unemployed) is determined by subtracting from the number of labor resources the number of employed and the number of economically inactive population according to the formula:  U = LR - E - EIP, where: U – unemployed population in need of employment (unemployed); LR – labor resources; E – employed;  EIP – economically inactive population. Detail: https://lex.uz/en/docs/3469431
unemployed_population.department: Department of Demography, Labor and Gender Statistics
notes: Preliminary data for  2025

population.methodology_url: Permanent population - consists of the population permanently residing in a certain locality or territory at the time of registration, including the population permanently registered in this territory but not temporarily residing. Estimate of the size of the permanent population - is calculated on the basis of the last population census, adding to it the number of people born and immigrating to a certain area each year, and subtracting the number of deaths and people who moved from a certain area. Detail: https://lib.stat.uz/uz/features/demografiya-va-mehnat/853-asosiy-demografik-ko-rsatkichlarni-shakllantirish-bo-yicha-uslubiy-nizom-2
